title: 3D full Coulomb construction algorithm for LibRPA reader-v1

out_librpa_3d_coulomb_method.meaning: Selects the 3D full auxiliary Coulomb construction written for LibRPA reader-v1: ewald (split-Ewald) or direct_reciprocal (positive Gram matrix).

adjust.symptom: EXX or GW bands are wrong on a large scale and the Coulomb matrix is suspect
adjust.effect: cross-check the same structure with the other algorithm (ewald versus direct_reciprocal) to separate a construction bug from a physics or basis problem
adjust.guard: direct_reciprocal needs rpa=1, out_librpa_reader_version=1, exx_ewald_dimension=3, and a converged out_librpa_3d_direct_ecut; there is no automatic fallback

constraints: direct_reciprocal is default-off and has no automatic fallback.
Record the method and its parameters in provenance; cross-algorithm results are not interchangeable definitions.
